title: Top 3 sources of UK AI imports, by product group, 2024-2025
units: Share of UK imports of each product group, %
source: HMRC Overseas Trade Statistics; ukmacro calculations
note: Upper bound: whole product groups, which contain AI and non-AI products (ONS has not yet published AI shares). AI compute hardware = IMF AI hardware basket; the other groups are the ONS-based AI products by type. EU imports are recorded by country of dispatch (so goods routed via e.g. Dutch distribution hubs count as the Netherlands); non-EU imports by country of origin. Shares are of all trade, including trade whose partner HMRC suppresses for confidentiality.
